title: Enrichment-Oriented Virtual Screening of Perovskite Solar Cells through Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.18043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Experimental optimization of perovskite solar cells is constrained by combinatorial diversity in absorber compositions, device layers, and processing, which makes virtual screening attractive for prioritizing recipes before fabrication. We develop a surrogate-guided reinforcement-learning framework that casts recipe generation as virtual screening, enriching candidate shortlists near high-performing experimental neighbors. A frozen Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) guides recipe generation, while a reference pool of 890 measured devices enables neighborhood-based assessment. Five-fold evaluation on 1,846 devices shows top-ten selection raises mean power conversion efficiency (PCE) from 19.68\% to 23.74\%. Three learned policies are compared with six baselines under 3,000 surrogate evaluations per run. In top-100 shortlists, Proximal policy optimization (PPO) and recurrent PPO (RPPO) achieve neighborhood-supported hit rates of 23

translated_title: 基于强化学习的钙钛矿太阳能电池富集导向虚拟筛选
translated_abstract: 钙钛矿太阳能电池的实验优化受限于吸收层组成、器件层结构和制备工艺的组合多样性，这使得虚拟筛选在制备前对配方进行优先排序方面极具吸引力。我们开发了一个代理模型引导的强化学习框架，将配方生成转化为虚拟筛选，在高性能实验样本的邻域内富集候选配方短名单。一个冻结的表格先验数据拟合网络引导配方生成，同时一个包含890个实测器件的参考池支持基于邻域的评估。在1,846个器件上的五折评估表明，前十个选择可将平均功率转换效率（PCE）从19.68%提升至23.74%。在每次运行3,000次代理评估的条件下，将三种学习到的策略与六个基线方法进行了比较。在前100名候选名单中，近端策略优化（PPO）和循环PPO（RPPO）实现了邻域支持的命中率23%（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一个以冻结TabPFN代理模型引导的强化学习框架，将钙钛矿太阳能电池配方生成建模为富集导向的虚拟筛选，使前十名候选配方的平均PCE从19.68%提升至23.74%，其中PPO和RPPO策略在前100名候选名单中获得了最高的邻域命中率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a reinforcement-learning framework guided by a frozen TabPFN surrogate that frames perovskite solar cell recipe generation as enrichment-oriented virtual screening, raising the mean PCE of top-ten selections from 19.68% to 23.74%, with PPO and RPPO achieving the highest neighborhood-supported hit rates in top-100 shortlists.
